title: Radiomics in hepatocellular carcinoma: a quantitative review

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Radiomics in hepatocellular carcinoma: a quantitative review》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】This review aims to assess whether radiomics is a useful and reproducible method for clinical management of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) by reviewing the strengths and weaknesses of current radiomics literature pertaining specifically to HCC.

evidence.text: This review aims to assess whether radiomics is a useful and reproducible method for clinical management of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) by reviewing the strengths and weaknesses of current radiomics literature pertaining specifically to HCC.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Radiomics in hepatocellular carcinoma: a quantitative review》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-11】Radiomics is still a very young field, and is far from being mature, but it remains a very promising technology for the future for developing adequate personalized treatment as a non-invasive approach, for complementing or replacing tumor biopsies, as well as for developing novel prognostic biomarkers in HCC patients.

evidence.text: Radiomics is still a very young field, and is far from being mature, but it remains a very promising technology for the future for developing adequate personalized treatment as a non-invasive approach, for complementing or replacing tumor biopsies, as well as for developing novel prognostic biomarkers in HCC patients.
